description.value: Atrevida is a fine-dining oceanfront restaurant at the Galiano Oceanfront Inn & Spa on Galiano Island, a popular Gulf Islands cycling destination accessible by BC Ferries. Under Executive Chef Dean Hillier, the kitchen focuses on carefully sourced BC and Pacific Northwest ingredients presented in a contemporary West Coast style, with sweeping ocean views as a backdrop. The restaurant serves both inn guests and the general public, making it a noteworthy dining destination for cyclists touring the island.

address.value: 134 Madrona Drive, Galiano Island, BC V0N 1P0
